audit_head_note: docs: refresh final deployment checklist — freshest pushed origin/main at audit start
fix_commit_note: fix(security): 4-team audit remediation — SHA-pin Actions, dbmate checksum, text-length caps, chat limit bound (local, NOT pushed)

evidence.snippet: uses: actions/checkout@v4 (and 29 other `uses:` lines across 9 workflows, 0 SHA pins; team2 note: repo has 9 workflow files, not 8)

findings.title: GitHub Actions pinned to mutable version tags, not commit SHAs

evidence.snippet: curl -fsSL -o /usr/local/bin/dbmate https://github.com/amacneil/dbmate/releases/download/v2.34.1/dbmate-linux-amd64 && chmod +x ... (same pattern Dockerfile.web:5-7; no SHA256/signature check)

findings.title: dbmate binary fetched via curl without checksum/signature verification in Dockerfiles

evidence.snippet: text=(request.form.get('message_text') or '').strip() — no length check before evaluate(); same on mobile/api.py:1135, uploadPost/routes.py:164 (comment), uploadPost/routes.py:115,261,295 (captions), mobile/api.py:1375 (mobile_comment); only global bound config.py:27 MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH=100MB; red team measured ~1.6s server CPU per MB

findings.title: No server-side max text length on chat messages, comments, or captions (DoS via huge bodies)

evidence.snippet: approval_body = Template(f.read()).render(parent_name=parent_name, ...) — plain jinja2.Template (autoescape off); parent_name only whitespace-stripped at :56; fallback f-string body at :311-316 also unescaped. Red team: recipient is OTP-bound to attacker's own inbox → no attacker→victim path

findings.title: Approval email renders unsanitized parent_name via jinja2.Template without autoescape

evidence.snippet: safe_limit = int(limit) if limit is not None else 2147483647 → raw LIMIT %s; mobile/api.py:1118 passes limit straight through; web chat.html path calls messages() with no limit. Red team live: limit=1000000000 → 2000 msgs, 4.75MB JSON. (Red team correction: parameterized LIMIT -1 raises → 500, not LIMIT ALL)

findings.title: Unbounded `limit` parameter in chat message history fetch

evidence.snippet: "cameraPermission": "LittleNet uses the camera for live face checks." (and :44 image-picker variant); face auth fully removed 2026-09-22; red team: camera plugin live in CreateScreen/VideoMedia/ReelPlayer → permission legitimate, strings stale, zero security impact

findings.title: Stale camera permission strings still claim removed 'face checks'

evidence.snippet: @limiter.limit('30 per minute') on web login; mobile/api.py:693 mobile; auth/api.py:255 /api/login/ 10/min; extensions.py:9 key_func=get_remote_address (IP-only); repo-wide grep for per-account failure tracking: zero hits. Red team live: 29 wrong-pw 401s → 30th 429 → correct password also 429; distributed N-IP attack unbounded per account

findings.title: Login rate limiting is per-IP only; no per-account throttling or lockout

evidence.snippet: productionApiUrlProblem() rejects non-https, localhost/127.0.0.1/::1, 10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x; missing fc00::/7, fe80::/10, 100.64.0.0/10, 169.254.0.0/16. Red team: guard runs only on build-time EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL, no runtime-controllable URL surface → not a security boundary, no attacker path

findings.title: Production API-URL guard misses IPv6/CGNAT/link-local private ranges

evidence.snippet: Local BLOCK returns before any AI call (childMessage/routes.py:115-118, mobile/api.py:1144-1147); AI outage → REVIEW fail-closed (:62-69); merge safety/text_service.py:293-309 max() + unconditional deterministic flags; media born PENDING/is_safe=FALSE; review comments invisible; unknown types → BLOCK. Red team: sustained break attempts, no downgrade path found

findings.title: LLM safety output is a verified one-way ratchet (can only escalate, never downgrade local BLOCK)

evidence.snippet: _TOKEN_TTL default 86400; sver claim :143 checked live at :220, bumped on logout :733; mobile_token_revocations fail-closed read :180-199; storage expo-secure-store. Red team live: logout killed token AND sibling sessions; 73/82 mobile endpoints carry @_require_mobile (10 public legit)

findings.title: Mobile bearer tokens live 24h (mitigated by server-side revocation)

evidence.snippet: _registration_error is LIVE — called at auth/api.py:239,241 inside parent_registration_email_gate before_app_request. Team1 dead-code claim wrong. Hygiene note: the math-challenge values it renders are inert (template states no challenge; challenge_expected never validated)

findings.title: Dead math-challenge registration helper no longer used

evidence.snippet: Job gated: if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[deploy-web]') }} — plain main push skips it. Team1 'every main push redeploys' claim contradicted. Residual: tag-triggered/manual deploy still lacks environment protection

findings.title: Web-only workflow auto-deploys to Modal on every main push

evidence.snippet: torchvision>=0.28,<0.29, nudenet>=3.4,<4, ultralytics>=8.3,<9 (only opencv pinned); requirements-text.txt torch>=2.13,<2.14, transformers>=5.0 (unbounded); requirements-safety.txt presidio-analyzer>=2.2,<3, spacy>=3.8,<4; Dockerfile:10/Dockerfile.web:10 install without lockfile/hashes; modal_ai.py inlines floating ranges.
